scope: User-authorized current-private-version Google callback, authenticated resource-read and one non-sensitive habit-click replay in the agent-controlled browser.

interpretation.proven: The current private version completes the Google callback and its authenticated resource-read routes reach the Worker with HTTP 200. The agent-controlled Browser Use surface rejects direct API navigation and the user-interface mutation request before a matching Worker mutation event is observed.
not_proven: A defect in an ordinary end-user browser
interpretation.decision: No production API rename, proxy, duplicate route, security relaxation, or visual change was made solely to bypass the test-surface guard.

next_required_evidence: Run one bounded A/B write-and-history replay in a controlled user runtime not subject to the agent browser API-request guard, then bind it to the currently deployed private version.
